details: Severe update storm: the brush 'brush' event fires on every mousemove and synchronously filters 200 points, mutates attributes on ~2400 circles (12 off-diagonal cells × 200), and recomputes KDE for 12 species/cell pairs—all with no RAF, debounce, or dirty-flag coalescing. The dispatch includes a source tag but the brushchange handler never checks it, though no actual infinite loop exists because opacity changes don't re-fire the dispatch.
